title: ReSplat
description: ReSplat (ETH Zurich / cvg): 3D Gaussian splats from several posed images, refined by rendering them back; saves a 3DGS .ply. MIT (DL3DV Small), non-commercial (Base).
html:
ReSplat (ETH Zurich / cvg): 3D Gaussian splats from several posed images, refined by rendering them back; saves a 3DGS .ply. MIT (DL3DV Small), non-commercial (Base).

Commercial use: resplat-small-dl3dv: yes; resplat-base-re10k: no (weights: CC-BY-NC-4.0).

Speed and memory not measured for: resplat-small-dl3dv, resplat-base-re10k.

Details
  • Paper: ReSplat: Learning Recurrent Gaussian Splats, arXiv, 2025-10-09
  • Original code: https://github.com/cvg/resplat at cae7ddc
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT
    • resplat-base-re10k: CC-BY-NC-4.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/cvg/resplat/blob/cae7ddc/LICENSE and https://github.com/cvg/resplat/blob/cae7ddc/MODEL_ZOO.md and https://huggingface.co/haofeixu/resplat/tree/c69ad72a49b8358ac46599cf74468090425ed9c7
  • Training data: DL3DV-10K (multi-view real-world scenes for 3D vision) (DL3DV-10K (non-commercial research licence), from DepthSplat / Depth Anything V2 Small depth initialisations.)
    • resplat-base-re10k: RealEstate10K (camera trajectories of YouTube real-estate videos) (RealEstate10K (YouTube videos, camera poses from ORB-SLAM; research use per its release), from a DepthSplat / Depth Anything V2 Base (CC-BY-NC-4.0) depth initialisation.)
  • Licence note: Code and checkpoints are MIT. The Base RealEstate10K checkpoint's monocular branch is initialised from Depth Anything V2 Base (CC-BY-NC-4.0) and is labelled non-commercial; the Small DL3DV checkpoint builds on Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0).
  • Options: long_side = 0 (>= 0), refine = 2 (>= 0)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, cudnn_hacc, gsraster
  • Variants: resplat-small-dl3dv, resplat-base-re10k
  • Outputs: depth, confidence, gaussians; kind: metric
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): resplat-small-dl3dv not measured yet; resplat-base-re10k not measured yet

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 5e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.01 and p99 <= 0.05 (absolute error of the output depth).
